## Slice S04 — Complete change impact and exact-snapshot review

Goal:
- Complete change impact and exact-snapshot review

Tasks:
- [ ] PORTABLE-DOC-T004 Complete change impact and exact-snapshot review
  - manifest: `task-manifests/PORTABLE-DOC-T004.yaml`
  - depends on: PORTABLE-DOC-T003
  - files: `scripts/amplai_docs.py`, `scripts/loopctl.py`, `scripts/loopv2.py`, `.ai-team/policy/documentation.json`, `.agents/skills/work/`, `.agents/skills/design/`, `.agents/skills/dev-loop/`, `tools/amplai-loop-kit/`, `tests/ai/test_document_review.py`, `specs/012-portable-document-lifecycle/`

Acceptance:
- ontology/binding pin changes invalidate relevant context and guide review
- updating only a domain helper cannot leave the existing Loop selecting old pins and docs
- 41+ changed paths, staged/unstaged/new/rename/delete and doc-only contract changes all participate
- limits, inaccessible inputs or parse errors cause incomplete rejection, not zero-impact PASS
- reviewed-unchanged acceptance binds current dependency/document/candidate hash, reason, reviewer, method and evidence
- whitespace/date changes, prior-revision review and changed document bytes cannot satisfy freshness
- normal feature work discovers affected guides without user-specified document paths and invokes source/update/HTML validation integration
- mandatory guide freshness cannot depend on a separate user /docs command

Eval:
- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/ai/test_document_review.py tests/ai/test_document_lifecycle.py`

Dependencies:
- S03
